before: Issue #598 -- the job this asset belongs to: the job it was registered on. The registration writes it with Job, and nothing changes it after but the office's change of job while the asset's history holds its Created entry alone (#583), which puts a registration right and moves both. Job is where the asset is now; while the two differ the asset is on loan from this job to that one -- lent by a site manager on this job (Lent), returned by a site manager on the job it went to (Returned to owner) -- and a retirement takes this job, so an asset retired on loan goes back to its owner as it ends. Single-record, app-enforced: the API refuses prefersSingleRecordLink. Filled from Job for the assets standing before #598 by scripts/import/fill_owner_job_598.mjs; made by scripts/import/add_owner_job_598.mjs on both bases.

before: Issue #540 -- when this asset's latest Asset Log event happened: a rollup of Asset Log."Event At" through Asset Log, MAX(values), kept by Airtable as each event is written. The Tools & Equipment list sorts its kinds by the latest of their items' (Recently updated) and a kind's page sorts its items by it and draws each one's Updated day from it. The list's status memory reads it with Status and Asset ID (lib/assetStatusMemory.js), and asks for an asset whose moment is past its last question, so the sort reads nothing more than the counts did. Empty only for an asset whose registration wrote no first log row (#449), which the lists order as the newest. Made by scripts/import/add_last_event_at_540.mjs on the test base and by hand on the live base, where no script reshapes this table (#531); its time is turned on by hand on both, since the API makes a rollup of a moment a day and cannot change its format.

before: The category group this item is filed under (#539): its type and its category, a row of Asset Category Groups. Pick one group: Level 1 and Level 2 look their values up through this field, so a category renamed in Asset Category Groups is renamed on every item filed under it. The app's Catalog page sets it when an item is added or edited; scripts/import/link_category_groups_539.mjs filled it from the typed Level 1 and Level 2.

before: Issue #540 -- when this catalog row was last edited, kept by Airtable: a Last modified time watching Level 3, Size, Maker, Part Number, Category Group and Discontinued, the fields the Catalog page writes, and nothing else. So adding a row, renaming it, changing its size, maker or part number, moving it to another category and discontinuing or restoring it move it; an item registered under it does not, since the reverse link is not watched, and neither does its category renamed in Asset Category Groups, since Level 1 and Level 2 are lookups. The Catalog page sorts by it (Recently updated). Made by scripts/import/add_edited_at_540.mjs.

before: Issue #582 -- the Status of every asset filed under this catalog row, joined with commas: a rollup of Assets."Status" through Assets, ARRAYJOIN(values, ","), kept by Airtable as each status is written. The catalog's page counts a row's items as its Assets link less the statuses the app does not show, Deleted among them (lib/assetCategory.js:itemCountOf, lib/assetStatus.js:shownIn), and takes a row out only when that count is 0; a kind's page reads it for whether any item stands under the kind at all. Airtable judges nothing here: which statuses count is the app's. Made by scripts/import/add_asset_statuses_582.mjs on the test base and by hand on the live base.
